verses.text: The story of Susanna was in the 1611 King James Version of the Bible removed from Daniel, and put into the Apocrypha instead, titled: “The historie of Susanna, set apart from the beginning of Daniel, because it is not in Hebrew, as neither the narration of Bel and the Dragon.” However, because Roman Catholic editions of the Bible (such as the 1609 Douay Old Testament) recognize it as the 13th chapter of Daniel, it appears here in the digitalized text of the 1611 KJV as Daniel 14.

This verse appears in the 1611 KJV not at the end of “The historie of Susanna” (commonly Daniel 13), as you will find it here, but at the beginning of the story of Bel and the Dragon (commonly Daniel 14).
